entities.summary: Svetlana Artykova (b. 1962, Uchqoʻrgʻon District) was a medical practitioner or physician of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Uchqoʻrgʻon District and Uzbekistan. Known in the fields of uzbekistan, jurists & legal scholars, asia.
